sample_unit: pediatric patients (typical and atypical Kawasaki disease cases)

links.outcome: Model accuracy versus pediatricians and ChatGPT for KD diagnosis, IVIG resistance, CAL prediction
links.effect: Model accuracies were 0.900, 0.800, and 0.757 for KD diagnosis, IVIG resistance, and CAL prediction, outperforming pediatricians with over 5 years of experience and ChatGPT.
links.quote: In a comparative study, our model achieved accuracies of 0.900, 0.800, and 0.757 for KD diagnosis, IVIG resistance, and CAL prediction, respectively, consistently outperforming pediatricians with over 5 years of experience and ChatGPT, highlighting its potential as a clinical decision support tool.

screen.reason: The study develops a predictive machine learning model (LightGBM) for Kawasaki disease diagnosis and risk prediction, and compares its accuracy against clinicians and an LLM (ChatGPT) in an offline reader/benchmark setting, without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
